result.reason: The redline implements a mutual USD 1,000,000/12-month amount floor, but the operative language supplied does not establish the required carve-outs; the margin comment cannot supply the missing definition of “Excluded Claims.” It also does not include the preferred mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages or clarify that Customer payment obligations are not damages. The cap formulation is otherwise targeted, though “all amounts ... under this Agreement and all Order Forms” is broader and less precise than “fees” and could create double-counting ambiguity.
